get_task: create a SQuAD DefaultTeacher task agent from an opt dictionary with datatype and datapath settings
QADataCollectionTaskWorld_generate_world: generate a QADataCollectionTaskWorld instance from opt and agent list using the generate_world static method
QADataCollectionTaskWorld_parley: run a two-turn parley that collects a user question and answer from a SQuAD context
QADataCollectionTaskWorld_assign_roles: assign the display role Agent to the first agent in the agents list
QADataCollectionTaskWorld_shutdown: shutdown the QADataCollectionTaskWorld by calling shutdown on both the task and agent
